review_comment: The sync file extraction performs a filesystem stat check to prevent overwriting newer files, but subsequent file operations occur without atomicity, creating a TOCTOU race condition. An attacker could modify the filesystem between the check and file operations to bypass the newer-file protection. Implement atomic file operations using file descriptors or proper locking to ensure the stat check and file operations occur on the same filesystem state.

The code adds a timestamp comparison to skip extracting archive entries when existing files are newer. This creates a TOCTOU race condition where file timestamps can change between the lstat check and actual file operations. An attacker manipulating timestamps could bypass the intended skip logic. Use atomic file operations like open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL flags or implement proper file locking to ensure timestamp consistency between check and write.
